static_traits.name: 杨安婕
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友和家人一起参与行动主义活动，但not yet与他们讨论自己的not足感
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理问题治疗经历；not yet曾出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能回忆具体事件；语气偏消极，频繁Self-denial；对正向反馈持怀疑态度；配合度尚可，愿意尝试但保持谨慎

basic_info.main_problem: 觉得自己的行动主义工作缺乏影响力与挑战性，导致自我not足感和缺乏满足感。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到自我not足感正在影响自己的目的感与整体满意度，因此希望通过咨询加以处理和改善。
growth_experiences: 约一年前因对Legal assistant工作的个人满足感较低，开始将其与行动主义工作进行比较；比较之后，两者都显得平淡与Meaninglessness，逐渐形成“我的努力not重要、任何人都能做”的自我贬低倾向。

core_beliefs: 我的贡献not具价值或影响力

special_situations.event: 社区会议结束后回顾自己的发言与贡献
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的贡献not独特或not显著，就have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing achievements to the collective and downplaying personal contributions to avoid self-expectations and external evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做的事谁都能做，I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 与他人讨论政治议题后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果看not到可见的改变或持续的认可，说明我的行动have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 强调需要外部认可、negate零星的正向反馈

special_situations.event: 将行动主义与Legal assistant工作进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果工作not具挑战性或意义，我就是平庸的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断比较两者以证明自身not足，降低自我期望
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 两边都很平淡、not意义，I am a failure

special_situations.event: Received positive feedback from friends or family (such as praise that a speech was inspiring)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果只有个do not人的赞赏，就not代表真正的价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将赞美解释为“只是好心”并予以negate，避免承认个人价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客套，我的表现not算好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a recognized sense of value and meaning through action and work
core_conflict.fear: 害怕自己平庸、Meaninglessness；害怕他人评价negate自己
defense_goal: 通过negate正向反馈与强调外部标准来降低自我期望，以避免面对可能的失败或批评
保持自我贬低以维持“安全”的低期待，减少被negate时的痛苦

object_relations.self_representation: 平庸、缺乏影响力的贡献者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是not真诚的评价者或更有能力的竞争者（赞美只是出于好意）
Strong collective and external standards (media, visible results, continuous recognition)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes one's achievements or invites recalling positive moments (such as a successful gathering)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些正面信息被过度美化、not够真实；担心被夸大后会被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以怀疑语气回应，use“这not算”“只是运气好”来negate正向信息，避免深入讨论个人贡献。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被具体追问“你做了什么让集会成功”时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感到被要求自我夸耀、担心暴露not足而被评判
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Attributes success mainly to collective and external factors ('everyone worked together', 'the media happened to pay attention'), avoiding talking about their personal concrete contributions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请列出近期的小成就或正向反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为小成就not重要，只有大成果与持续认可才算价值
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use“应该/必须”类语句强调高标准，弱化“鼓舞了一个人”等微小成果的重要性。

manifestations: 认为行动主义工作not够有影响力与挑战性
将Legal assistant工作与行动主义比较后，两者都显得平淡与not重要
Positive moments (successful gatherings, inspiring others) are also quickly downplayed
outcomes: 目的感与整体满意度受损
与朋友和家人的关系受到影响

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Emphasizes needing 'visible results' and 'continuous recognition' to count as value
以高外部标准评判自身，negate微小成就

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 在被赞美时转而强调not足与限制
以“这只是一个人”等说法弱化正向反馈

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复说“I am not good enough”并Self-denial
对积极建议持怀疑态度但谨慎尝试

exception_events.target_problem: 在参与行动活动或讨论政治议题后，来访者通常会negate自身贡献、产生“I am not good enough”的想法，并感到not满足与Meaninglessness。
exception_events.unique_outcome: At a successfully organized gathering, on-site participation was high and it received media coverage; at the time the client felt influential and connected, experiencing a brief sense of satisfaction and meaning.
exception_events.reason: 线索：集体协作Good、传播有效、现场互动积极并获得外部关注与反馈，使得来访者更容易觉察到具体影响。

positive_force: Has organizational and coordination abilities (once successfully organized a rally and gained media attention)
Has a social support network of friends and family
愿意尝试记录小成就等新方法、配合度尚可
Can clearly express and recall specific events, with a foundation of self-observation
negative_force: Relies on external approval (External Validation), finding it hard to internalize self-worth
心理过滤与过度概括导致自我贬低

target_behavior.behavior: 在行动主义与工作相关情境中出现自我贬低与negate正向的自动化思维（如“I am not good enough”“任何人都能做”）
antecedent: 与他人讨论政治议题时
收到来自朋友或家人的正面反馈时
将行动主义与Legal assistant工作进行比较时
target_behavior.core_reason: 受“I am not good enough”“我的贡献not具价值”的核心信念驱动，并对外部认可高度依赖；伴随心理过滤、过度概括与比较倾向。
target_behavior.function: Self-protection与逃避潜在的失败与被评判的Anxiety（通过降低自我期望与negate正向来减少not适）。
target_behavior.consequence: 主观满足感与目的感降低；Interpersonal relationships受影响；行动动力与Decline in job satisfaction。
